text: Long catch-up with Meera. She's sitting her driving test again on Thursday, third go, and she's a wreck about it. Her brother Rohan passed first time which doesn't help. Text her good luck Wednesday night.

Coffee with Jonah and Gemma. They're moving to Leeds sometime in the spring, no fixed date yet. Gemma has a job lined up at the hospital there. Jonah still hasn't told his boss. Gemma's mum lives up there so they'll stay with her while they look. Gemma said the first viewings are probably sometime next month. Both of them seemed excited but tired, they've been arguing about whether to rent or buy.

Andile called. Results day for his nursing exams is May 14 and he's trying not to think about it. Spent most of the call on football, he's a huge Arsenal fan. Ask him how it went that afternoon. His sister Matilda is also waiting on her driving test result, so it's a big week in their house. Andile wants to go out on the Saturday either way.

Bumped into Seo-yeon at the station. Her flat viewing on Saturday fell through, the landlord pulled it. She's now looking at places in Walthamstow. Her cat Dumpling is apparently not a fan of all the boxes.
Farid's audition for the conservatoire is next Tuesday. He's been practising cello six hours a day. His mum is more nervous than he is, honestly. Don't forget to message him on Monday.

Dinner with Marisol and Aurelio. They finally got the keys, moving in June 3rd. She wants a proper coffee machine for the new kitchen, could be a housewarming present. He's doing all the painting himself, poor man.
Yara rang, sounding flat. Failed her theory test yesterday by two marks. She's rebooked for a fortnight from now. Should check in on her this weekend.
Quick one. Alfie got into Edinburgh! Starts after Christmas, January intake. Teresa (his mum) is thrilled but already dreading the empty house.
Caught up with Lior over lunch. He's been at the bank eleven years now. Coeliac, so remember that for the dinner next month. Loves bouldering, goes three times a week.

Hoang and his wife are relocating to Melbourne soon, maybe after the summer. Her parents are out there. He said the visa stuff is a nightmare. Ask Hoang for a date once they know so we can do a send off.
Grace's grade 8 piano exam got cancelled, examiner was ill. Rescheduled to 6/12. She's annoyed because she'd peaked. Her dad Ethan is driving her up to Manchester for it.
Must sort the car MOT before Friday. Also post office tomorrow.
Matilda's moving out of her mum's place this weekend, into a flatshare in Brighton with two girls from uni. She starts her teaching placement Monday. Nervous about both. Send her a text Sunday night.
Wiremu says the rugby trials are on the 9th, which for him means September 9. His partner Chantal is due in early October so timing is tight. He's hoping to get selected before the baby comes.

Long chat with Abebe after church. His daughter has her A level results on August 13th and he's more anxious than she is. He's also thinking about moving closer to his sister in Bristol, maybe next year. Nice to see him laugh again after the past few months. His wife passed in March and he's only just started coming back to church. He mentioned he'd love help clearing the garage before any move. I should offer a Saturday.
Dimitri passed his citizenship test! Took it last Thursday, found out this morning. Want to get him something small to celebrate, he likes Greek wine.

Rohan and Aditi viewed a three bed in Didsbury on Saturday and loved it. Putting an offer in tomorrow. Aditi's mum is helping with the deposit. Fingers crossed for them. Rohan says if it goes through they'd want to complete by June 3rd so they're in before Aditi starts her new job. They've got a little terrier, Mochi, so they need a garden. Offer to help with the move if it happens.
Ellie's off to Lisbon for a month in the spring for work. She's renting out her room while she's away. Her dog Pickle is going to her brother Leon's.
Need to ring Lwazi. He mentioned his dad's surgery is Tuesday the 21st and I never asked how the consult went. Feel bad.
Abdi texted. His bar exam results come out November 4. He's been doom-scrolling forums all week. Plan: take him for a pint the night before so he isn't alone with it.
Gemma O'Brien from work, apparently goes by Gem. Just moved here from Cork last month, doesn't know anyone yet. Big into wild swimming. Invite her to the Sunday swim group.
Yaw has a job interview on Wednesday with a firm in Glasgow. If he gets it they'd move up in the new year. His wife Anjali is keen, the kids less so.
Note to self: council tax change of address form, and cancel the old broadband. Moving van booked for the 28th.
Matteo and Mateo (the two Matts, confusing) are both doing the half marathon on April 19. Matteo's injured his knee though so might pull out. Mateo is aiming for under two hours.
Chatted with Teresa at the school gates. Her son is doing his eleven plus in a couple of weeks and she's not sleeping. She's also thinking of selling the house soon, too big now.
Grace called about Ethan. He's struggling a lot since moving to Aberdeen, really isolated. She wants us both to visit sometime next month. I should book trains.
Seo-yeon's sister got her visa approved, flying in on 7/22. Seo-yeon is over the moon. She's planning a welcome dinner the weekend after.

Andile and his girlfriend are going to look at flats in Bristol next Saturday and Sunday. He's transferring with work, starts there in a month or so. Ask how the viewings went. His girlfriend Chantal is less sure, she's never lived outside London and her whole family is here. They're going to decide by Tuesday whether to sign anything. Andile thinks she'll come round once she sees the harbourside.
Farid did brilliantly at the audition apparently, got a recall for March 2nd. Remind me to send congrats and a good luck text before the recall.
Spent the evening with Marisol. She's quietly applying for jobs in Valencia, wants to go back home within the year. Loves her nephews there. Aurelio doesn't know yet.
Mrs Patel next door said her grandson Rohan passed his driving test on the first try this morning. She's very proud. Card through the door tomorrow?
Meera passed!! Finally. Third time lucky. She's already talking about a road trip in the summer with her cousin Aditi.
Lior's wedding was meant to be in May but it's off, they split up last month. He's moving back in with his parents for now. Check in with him next week, gently.
Jonah's mum is having a knee replacement on October 30. He's taking a week off to look after her. Offer to drop round some food.

Alfie is retaking his maths GCSE in November. Really struggling with confidence. Teresa asked if I could help with some tutoring on Tuesdays and Thursdays. I'm doing Tuesday after school, starting next week.
Yara mentioned her landlord's selling and she has to be out by 12/1. Viewing two places on Friday and one on Monday. She sounded stressed. Text her Friday evening to see how it went.
Hoang's son took his first violin grade yesterday, results in about three weeks. Hoang says he's a natural. Also they've got a new rescue greyhound called Biscuit.
Dinner at Abdi's. His brother Yaw is staying with them until he finds somewhere in Leeds. Abdi does all the cooking, vegetarian, very good. Yaw starts at the university next month.
Pick up prescription, return library books, buy birthday card for Wednesday.
Chantal is having a gender reveal thing on Saturday the 15th. Wiremu is in charge of the cake. Don't forget to RSVP by Tuesday.

Matilda says the move went fine but she hates Brighton so far. Housemates are loud and the placement school is chaotic. She's hoping it settles down after half term. I should call her this weekend, she sounded low. Her mum Grace is worried too and asked me to keep an eye on her. Maybe send her a care package with the good tea she likes.
Ran into Dr Fischer at the pharmacy. Retiring at the end of the year after thirty years at the practice. Moving to the coast with his wife. Lovely man.

Ellie's interview for the Lisbon secondment went well, she thinks. Hears back by Friday. Her brother Leon has his own interview on 3/18, same week. Busy household. Their mum is visiting from Leeds this weekend to help them prep, which Ellie says is not helping at all. Leon's been practising answers in the kitchen every night. Text them both good luck on Thursday.
Aditi says Rohan is terrified about his viva on May 7th. He's barely eating. She's taking him away for the weekend after it's done. Need to send him a good luck message the day before.

Dimitri and his wife are celebrating their 25th anniversary on June 20th. He wants to surprise her with a trip to Crete. He's into olive oil tasting now, of all things. He asked me to keep it quiet around her. Flights would be the week of June 18. He also said his son Leon is doing his finals around then, so it might clash. Remind me to send him the name of that hotel in Chania.
Gemma got her offer from the hospital in Leeds, starts July 1. Jonah is officially resigning on Monday. They're house hunting this weekend and next.
Quick call with Anjali. The kids have their swimming badges test next Thursday. She's starting a pottery class in the new year. Seems much happier these days.
Andile's results came back. Passed everything! He's celebrating Saturday at his mum's place. Send him a congrats text tonight.

Marisol and Aurelio's move got pushed back again, now sometime after Easter. Their buyer's mortgage fell through. Marisol is pretty fed up and says if it slips past May 14 they'll lose the removal firm deposit. Aurelio is being annoyingly calm about it. Meanwhile her sister is getting married in Seville in June, so the whole summer is a mess. Ask Marisol next week whether the buyer has sorted a new lender.
Barbecue at Mateo's. His daughter Ellie just finished her driving lessons, test booked for 8/30. His mother-in-law is visiting from Lima for the whole summer. Mateo cooks a mean picanha.
Teresa's son passed the eleven plus! Got into the grammar school, starts in September. She cried on the phone. Must get him a little something.
Farid moved into halls on Sunday. His mum dropped him off and apparently cried the whole way home. Ask him next week how he's settling in.
Thinking I should finally book my own driving theory test. Maybe early next month.
Lwazi's dad came through the surgery fine. Home by Friday. Lwazi is exhausted though, been sleeping at the hospital. Bring them dinner one evening this week.
Uncle Abebe phoned, he's selling the shop and moving to Addis in the new year to be near his brothers. Big change. Wants a farewell lunch with the family sometime in January.
Seo-yeon finally found a flat, moving November 8. Her cat Dumpling has a vet appointment the day before, vaccinations. She's asked if I can help carry boxes. I'm bringing the car on the Saturday.
Talked to Yaw and Abdi about their mum. She's got her citizenship interview on Monday and is very nervous about her English. They're both going with her. Abdi asked me to ring her Sunday to practise.
Gem from work did her first open water race last weekend, came fourth in her age group. She loves it here now. Planning to do the Windermere swim next summer.
Nothing much. Ethan's fine, Grace says hi.

Leon got the job! Starts April 6. Ellie is relieved since she was worried about leaving him alone while she's in Lisbon. He's moving into her room while she's away. Should take him out for drinks to celebrate before he starts, maybe the Friday before.
